name: BitBake Variable Resolver
blurb: the final value of a BitBake variable from its assignments, overrides and :append/:remove, step by step
intro: Evaluates pasted conf, recipe and bbappend lines the way the BitBake datastore does: = ?= ??= := += =+ .= =. in parse order, then override selection by OVERRIDES, :append, :prepend, ${} expansion and :remove when the value is read. Each character of the result is traced to the line that wrote it.

inputs.label: Lines in parse order
inputs.default:
# file: build/conf/local.conf
MACHINE ??= "imx6ullevk"
DISTRO ?= "poky"
DISTRO_FEATURES += "pam"
DISTRO_FEATURES:append = " systemd usrmerge"
DISTRO_FEATURES:remove = "x11 3g nfc"
DISTRO_FEATURES:append:mx6ull-nxp-bsp = " ${IMX_EXTRA_FEATURES}"
IMX_EXTRA_FEATURES = "wifi bluetooth"
VIRTUAL-RUNTIME_init_manager = "systemd"

# file: meta-poky/conf/distro/poky.conf
DISTRO_NAME = "Poky (Yocto Project Reference Distro)"
POKY_DEFAULT_DISTRO_FEATURES = "opengl ptest multiarch wayland vulkan"
DISTRO_FEATURES ?= "${DISTRO_FEATURES_DEFAULT} ${POKY_DEFAULT_DISTRO_FEATURES}"

# file: meta/conf/distro/include/default-distrovars.inc
DISTRO_FEATURES_DEFAULT:remove:riscv32 = "seccomp"
DISTRO_FEATURES_DEFAULT ?= "acl alsa bluetooth debuginfod ext2 ipv4 ipv6 pcmcia usbgadget usbhost wifi xattr nfs zeroconf pci 3g nfc x11 vfat seccomp"
DISTRO_FEATURES ?= "${DISTRO_FEATURES_DEFAULT}"
inputs.help: Mark files with '# file: path' or '==> path <==', or paste grep -n output (path:line:text). Order = parse order: local.conf, machine, distro, then recipe, then bbappends.

inputs.label: Variable
inputs.help: Empty = the variable with the most lines.

inputs.label: OVERRIDES
inputs.help: From bitbake -e <recipe> | grep ^OVERRIDES=. Later entries have higher priority. ${MACHINE} ${DISTRO} ${PN} are expanded. Used unless the lines set OVERRIDES.

inputs.label: MACHINE
inputs.help: Used if the lines do not set it.

inputs.label: Overrides switched off
inputs.help: Colon-separated, taken out of OVERRIDES for a what-if.

inputs.label: Overrides added
inputs.help: Colon-separated, added at the end (highest priority).

examples.title: linux-yocto KERNEL_FEATURES and KBRANCH with a bbappend, qemuarm (grep -n paste)

input.text:
meta/recipes-kernel/linux/linux-yocto_6.6.bb:1:KBRANCH ?= "v6.6/standard/base"
meta/recipes-kernel/linux/linux-yocto_6.6.bb:10:KBRANCH:qemuarm  ?= "v6.6/standard/arm-versatile-926ejs"
meta/recipes-kernel/linux/linux-yocto_6.6.bb:11:KBRANCH:qemuarm64 ?= "v6.6/standard/qemuarm64"
meta/recipes-kernel/linux/linux-yocto_6.6.bb:17:KBRANCH:qemux86-64 ?= "v6.6/standard/base"
meta/recipes-kernel/linux/linux-yocto_6.6.bb:59:KERNEL_EXTRA_FEATURES ?= "features/netfilter/netfilter.scc"
meta/recipes-kernel/linux/linux-yocto_6.6.bb:60:KERNEL_FEATURES:append = " ${KERNEL_EXTRA_FEATURES}"
meta/recipes-kernel/linux/linux-yocto_6.6.bb:61:KERNEL_FEATURES:append:qemuall=" cfg/virtio.scc features/drm-bochs/drm-bochs.scc cfg/net/mdio.scc"
meta/recipes-kernel/linux/linux-yocto_6.6.bb:63:KERNEL_FEATURES:append:qemux86-64=" cfg/sound.scc cfg/paravirt_kvm.scc"
meta/recipes-kernel/linux/linux-yocto_6.6.bb:65:KERNEL_FEATURES:append = " ${@bb.utils.contains("DISTRO_FEATURES", "ptest", " features/scsi/scsi-debug.scc", "", d)}"
meta-myboard/recipes-kernel/linux/linux-yocto_%.bbappend:1:FILESEXTRAPATHS:prepend := "${THISDIR}/files:"
meta-myboard/recipes-kernel/linux/linux-yocto_%.bbappend:2:SRC_URI += "file://can.cfg file://0001-arm-dts-add-mcp2515.patch"
meta-myboard/recipes-kernel/linux/linux-yocto_%.bbappend:3:KBRANCH:qemuarm = "v6.6/standard/base"
meta-myboard/recipes-kernel/linux/linux-yocto_%.bbappend:4:KERNEL_FEATURES:append = "features/can/can.scc"
meta-myboard/recipes-kernel/linux/linux-yocto_%.bbappend:5:KERNEL_FEATURES:remove = "cfg/net/mdio.scc"

usage: Give text: the assignment lines in parse order with file markers ('# file: path' or grep -n 'path:line:text'), var: the variable to resolve, overrides: the OVERRIDES string (later = higher priority; ${MACHINE} ${DISTRO} ${PN} filled from machine/distro/pn), and optionally off/add to switch overrides for a what-if. Returns the final value, which override variant won, the evaluation table (each line's effect and the value after it, then the getVar steps: override choice, :append, :prepend, expansion, :remove), a bitbake -e style history, and warnings for the classic mistakes (+= before ?= defaults, :append without a leading space, old _append syntax, bad operator combinations). Use it to explain why a variable has the value it has without running bitbake.
sources: BitBake User Manual, Syntax and Operators and Conditional Syntax (Overrides), bitbake-user-manual-metadata.rst
openembedded-core meta/conf/bitbake.conf (parse order of local.conf, machine and distro conf; OVERRIDES)
